_comment: The top of the frequency scale, as `colossal` is the top of size, and uninterrupted wherever a thing can be:
rain that never stops (`AgeWeather.keepRaining`), a fog or a blizzard that never lifts, a tempest that never
breaks, a sandfall always walking, meteor storms back to back; a curtain every night and a bow every day.
Laid bare, the weather and the phenomena each feel it one Age in four, since none of that is a thing to stumble
into; a curtain and a bow are never brought in unasked.
